description: Project infrastructure setup: directory structure, Docker Compose, database configuration, and core dependencies. Creates the foundation with PostgreSQL, Redis, FastAPI app skeleton, Celery worker setup, Alembic migrations, and all configuration files. This feature is independent and must be completed first as all other features depend on it.
steps: Create complete directory structure: app/{__init__.py,main.py,api/routes/,core/,models/,schemas/,services/,tasks/,templates/}, tests/{conftest.py,unit/,integration/,e2e/}, alembic/, data/certificates/

Create pyproject.toml with pinned dependencies: fastapi==0.109.2, uvicorn[standard]==0.27.1, sqlalchemy==2.0.27, alembic==1.13.1, psycopg2-binary==2.9.9, pydantic==2.6.1, pydantic-settings==2.1.0, celery==5.3.6, redis==5.0.1, reportlab==4.1.0, pytest==8.0.0, pytest-asyncio==0.23.5, pytest-cov==4.1.0, httpx==0.26.0, python-multipart==0.0.9

Create docker-compose.yml with 4 services: postgres (image: postgres:15-alpine, env: POSTGRES_USER/PASSWORD/DB, port 5432, volume for data), redis (image: redis:7-alpine, port 6379), api (build: ., command: uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --reload, port 8000, depends_on postgres+redis, volume mount for hot reload), worker (build: ., command: celery -A app.core.celery_app worker --loglevel=info, depends_on postgres+redis, shared volume with api for certificates)
Create Dockerfile with multi-stage build: base with Python 3.12-slim, install system deps (gcc, postgresql-dev), copy pyproject.toml, install dependencies with pip, copy app code, set PYTHONPATH

Create .env.example with all required variables: DATABASE_URL=postgresql://certgen:password@postgres:5432/certgen, REDIS_URL=redis://redis:6379/0, CELERY_BROKER_URL, CELERY_RESULT_BACKEND, APP_ENV=development, LOG_LEVEL=INFO, MAX_RECIPIENTS_PER_JOB=1000, CERTIFICATE_STORAGE_PATH=/app/data/certificates
Create app/core/config.py: Pydantic Settings class with all env vars, database_url, redis_url, celery config, app settings, validator for paths
Create app/core/database.py: SQLAlchemy engine with async support (create_async_engine), AsyncSession factory, Base declarative class, get_db dependency for FastAPI with proper cleanup
Create app/core/celery_app.py: Celery app instance with Redis broker/backend, task autodiscover from app.tasks, configuration for result serializer and task settings
Initialize Alembic: run 'alembic init alembic', configure alembic.ini with sqlalchemy.url from config, modify alembic/env.py to import Base and models, set target_metadata = Base.metadata

Create app/main.py skeleton: FastAPI app with title='Bulk Certificate Generator API', version='1.0.0', CORS middleware (allow origins for dev), include_router for jobs and certificates, startup event to create data/certificates directory
Create app/__init__.py files in all subdirectories to make them proper Python packages
acceptance_criteria: docker-compose up -d starts all 4 services without errors
PostgreSQL accessible at localhost:5432 with credentials from .env
FastAPI app responds at http://localhost:8000 with default routes
Celery worker starts and connects to Redis broker
All __init__.py files present for proper package imports
verification: Run: docker-compose up -d && docker-compose ps - verify all 4 containers running
Run: docker-compose logs api - verify FastAPI started without errors
Run: docker-compose logs worker - verify Celery worker connected
Run: curl http://localhost:8000/docs - verify Swagger UI loads
Run: docker-compose exec postgres psql -U certgen -d certgen -c '\dt' - verify DB connection
Run: docker-compose exec api alembic current - verify Alembic configured
